body.p: The status of the claims of the current application stands as follows:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vessel in contact with the vessel wall, said device comprising:a flexible sensor frame formed in an open center loop;
an expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil comprising a plurality of adjacent wire strands wrapped on the flexible sensor frameformed around an the open center to allow substantially unimpeded blood flow therethrough, said coil configured and dimensioned (i) to extend around an inner periphery of the vessel when implanted therein and (ii) to move with the vessel wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vessel; and
a capacitance which together with said variable inductance coil forms a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency correlated to the diameter or area of the expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil.
2. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein said expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil comprises plural wire strands arranged to extend around the open center in a lengthwise direction of the strands, and;said inductance changes based on changes in cross-sectional area or diameter across the coil open center in response to expansion and collapse of said coil.
3. (Previously Presented) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein said capacitance consists essentially of an inherent capacitance produced by spaces between said adjacent wire strands.
4. (Previously Presented) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein said capacitance comprises a capacitor in electrical communication with said wire strands.
5. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein said plurality of wire strands are each individually insulated, and wherein said device is configured and
dimensioned to be implanted within the patient's Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) in contact with the IVC wall.
6. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 5, wherein said device is configured to collapse with the IVC in an anterior-posterior direction from a generally circular cross-section to an oval or flattened cross-section without distortion of the vessel shape.
7. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein each strand is individually insulated and said plurality of wire strands and flexible sensor frame are covered together by an outer layer.
8. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 47,wherein the plurality of wire strands fully surround the flexible sensor framefurther comprising a flexible sensor frame formed in an open center loop supporting said expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil.
9. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 8, wherein:said device is configured and dimensioned to be implanted in the patient's vena cava;
and the flexible sensor frame is configured and dimensioned to form a loop surrounding an inner periphery of the vena cava when implanted therein, said loop being radially collapsible and expandable when implanted and having a combination of flexibility and stiffness selected to (i) support and maintain said variable inductance coil in contact with the vena cava wall, (ii) allow the vena cava to collapse and expand over the respiratory and cardiac cycles, and (iii) allow the variable inductance coil supported by said frame to change shape as a magnitude of collapse and expansion of the vena cava varies with vascular fluid volume of the patient.
10. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein said plurality of adjacent wire strands comprise plural side-by-side strands formed in at least one continuous loop around the open center.
11. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 10, wherein said plurality of said plural side-by-side strands are in contact and electrically insulated from one another.
12. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vessel in contact with the vessel wall, said device comprising:a flexible sensor frame comprising a flexible elongate member formed into a loop and joined together at opposite ends to form an open center surrounded by the flexible elongate member;
a resilient variable inductance coil formed on said flexible sensor frame around an the open center, said coil comprising a plurality of adjacent wire strands, said coil configured and dimensioned (i) to extend around an inner periphery of the vessel when implanted therein and (ii) to move with the vessel wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vessel; and
a capacitance which together with said variable inductance coil forms a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency correlated to the diameter or area of the expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil.
13. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 12, wherein said wire strands are wrapped on a resilient frame with each wire strand of said plurality of adjacent wire strands is in contact along a length direction with plural other strands of said plurality of adjacent wire strands.
14. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 13, wherein said plural plurality of adjacent wire strands are isformed by a plurality of individual wires each wrapped a single time around the open center.
15. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 13, wherein said plural plurality of adjacent wire strands are isformed by one or more individual wires each wrapped plural times around the open center.
16. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device, comprising a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency configured and
dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vessel in contact with the vessel wall,
wherein:
said resonant circuit including a variable inductance coil comprising plural adjacent wire strands twisted into bundles with said bundles forming at least one loop around an open center; and
said variable inductance coil is configured and dimensioned to extend around an inner periphery of the vessel when implanted therein and move with the vessel wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vessel, the inductance of said coil varying with said expansion and collapse;
whereby the variable characteristic frequency of said resonant circuit is correlated to the diameter or area defined by the vessel wall as it expands and contracts in response to changes in patient fluid volume.
17. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 16, wherein each of said wire strands is in side-by-side contact with more than one of said plural adjacent wire strands.
18. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 16, wherein the plurality of wire strands are each individually insulated and further covered by an outer coating over all said strands.
19. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 18, wherein said plural adjacent wire strands are formed by a plurality of individual wires each wrapped a single time around the open center.
20. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 18, wherein said plural adjacent strands are formed by one or more individual wires each wrapped plural times around the open center.
21. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 16, wherein said device is configured and dimensioned to be implanted within the patient's Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) in contact with the IVC wall.
22. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 21, wherein said device is configured to collapse with the IVC in an anterior-posterior direction from a generally circular cross-section to an oval or flattened cross-section.
23. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 22, wherein said device is configured to exert a radial force in the range of about 0.05N - 0.3N at 50% compression,whereby excessive distortion of the IVC's natural shape is avoided while maintaining secure implantation in the IVC.
24. (Currently Amended) An implantable body lumen monitoring device configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient body lumen in contact with the lumen wall, said device comprising:an expandable and collapsible coil comprising a plurality of wire strands twisted together into plural bundles with said bundles wrapped together in at least one loop around an open center, said wire strands lying in contact with adjacent wire strands along their length and aligned substantially circumferentially around an inner peripheral surface of said lumen when implanted therein.
25. (Previously Presented) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 24, wherein said device comprises a resonant circuit formed by an inductance of said expandable and collapsible coil and a device capacitance.
26. (Original) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 25, wherein said device capacitance comprises a discrete capacitor.
27. (Previously Presented) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 25, wherein said device capacitance consists essentially of an inherent capacitance of the device structure tuned to a selected capacitance value.
28. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vessel in contact with the vessel wall, said device comprising:a resilient variable inductance coil comprising at least one bundle of wire strands, the ends of which are connected together to complete at least one loop, said coil
configured and dimensioned (i) to extend around an inner periphery of the vessel when implanted therein, the coil extending around an open center to allow substantially unimpeded blood flow therethrough, and (ii) to move with the vessel wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vessel;
a flexible sensor frame with an open center, the at least one bundle of wire strands disposed on the flexible sensor frame in contact with said frame all around the open center;and
a capacitance which together with said variable inductance coil forms a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency correlated to the diameter or area of the expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil.
29. (Canceled)
30. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vesselinferior vena cava (IVC) in contact with the vessel inside of the IVC wall, said device comprising:a resilient variable inductance coil comprising a plurality of windings wire strands twisted together and each having at least one turn around an open center of the coil, said coil configured and dimensioned (i) to extend around an inner periphery of the vessel IVC when implanted therein, the coil extending around an the open center to allow substantially unimpeded blood flow therethrough, and (ii) to move with the vessel IVC wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vessel; and
a capacitance which together with said variable inductance coil forms a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency correlated to the diameter or area of the expandable and collapsible variable inductance coil.
31. (Currently Amended) An implantable vessel monitoring device, comprising a variable inductance resonant circuit having a variable characteristic frequency configured and dimensioned to be implanted in a patient blood vesselinferior vena cava (IVC) in contact with the vessel IVC wall, wherein:said resonant circuit including a variable inductance coil comprising an elongate bundle of wire strands formed in a continuous loop around an open center; and
said variable inductance coil is configured and dimensioned to extend circumferentially around an inner periphery of the vessel IVC when implanted therein and move with the vessel IVC wall in response to expansion and collapse of the vesselIVC, the inductance of said coil varying with said expansion and collapse;
whereby the variable characteristic frequency of said resonant circuit is correlated to the diameter or area defined by the vessel IVC wall as it expands and contracts in response to changes in patient fluid volume.
32. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 25, wherein said expandable and collapsible coil is wrapped around the open center in a single loop bundle of multiple wire strands.
33. (Currently Amended) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 25, wherein said expandable and collapsible coil is wrapped around the open center in multiple loops bundles of multiple wire strands.
34. (Previously Presented) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 25, wherein said expandable and collapsible coil comprises 180 to 1000 individual wire strands.
35. (New) The implantable vessel monitoring device of claim 1, wherein each wire strand of said plurality of adjacent wire strands is in contact along a length direction with plural other strands of said plurality of adjacent wire strands.
